# Acceptance is not successful application

Provenance: synthetic report-phase checkpoint in codex-baseline-R8-failure-replay-1, fixture-base → fixture-candidate; not an observed production incident or a live independent review. The supplied independent reviewer reports P1. The supplied PAL result failed before source processing (0 files checked), so this finding is not corroborated.

Pattern: a write adapter must preserve the contract's application-success signal across provider boundaries. Replacing an `applied` check with a provider `ok` check can acknowledge a save that left state unchanged when the provider accepts a request but rejects application. In this fixture, a read-only provider returns ok=true/applied=false and retains theme=light while the candidate reports success saving theme=dark. Preserve the applied-status check and cover accepted-but-unapplied responses. Evidence is supplied source inspection only; no tests were executed and no deployed revision was supplied.
